en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abdullah Bin Maymoun Al Qaddah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Yaqoub<sup>as</sup> said to his<sup>as</sup> son<sup>as</sup>: ‘Do not commit adultery, for the bird, if it commits adultery, its feathers fall off’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from ‘Abd Allah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
Ya’qub said to his son, ‘O son, do not commit fornication; even if a bird commits fornication it loses its feathers.’”
